title: Third Person
features: Tape Cam 2 times to activate script. It is permanently until you emote.
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Camera Settings
local CAMERA_OFFSET = Vector3.new(2, 2.5, 9)
local SENSITIVITY = 0.45

local cameraEnabled = false
local cameraAngleX = 0
local cameraAngleY = -10
local lastTouchPos = nil

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. FORCE CAMERA & PLAYER SETTINGS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function enableThirdPerson()
	LocalPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
	
	-- Store current facing direction
	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		local _, yRot, _ = character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame:ToOrientation()
		cameraAngleX = math.deg(yRot)
		cameraAngleY = -10
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. COMPACT UI TOGGLE BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "CamToggleGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Name = "CamToggle"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 32)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.9, -80, 0.15, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 40, 60)
toggleBtn.Text = "CAM: OFF"
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 195, 225)
toggleBtn.TextSize = 12
toggleBtn.FontFace = Font.fromName("FredokaOne")
toggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
toggleBtn.Parent = screenGui

local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
btnCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. TOUCH / DRAG INPUTS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed or not cameraEnabled then return end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		lastTouchPos = input.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if not cameraEnabled or not lastTouchPos then return end
	
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		local currentPos = input.Position
		local delta = currentPos - lastTouchPos
		lastTouchPos = currentPos
		
		cameraAngleX = cameraAngleX - (delta.X * SENSITIVITY)
		cameraAngleY = math.clamp(cameraAngleY - (delta.Y * SENSITIVITY), -60, 60)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		lastTouchPos = nil
	end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. OVERRIDE CAMERA LOOP (RenderPriority Override)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Priority set to Camera.Value + 1 so it overrides built-in camera scripts
RunService:BindToRenderStep("OverrideThirdPersonCam", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
	if not cameraEnabled then return end

	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not character then return end
	
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not head or not rootPart then return end

	-- Enforce Scriptable camera every frame
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable

	local startCFrame = CFrame.new(head.Position)
	local rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(cameraAngleX), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(cameraAngleY), 0, 0)
	
	camera.CFrame = startCFrame * rotation * CFrame.new(CAMERA_OFFSET.X, CAMERA_OFFSET.Y, CAMERA_OFFSET.Z)
	rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(rootPart.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(cameraAngleX), 0)
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. TOGGLE HANDLER
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	cameraEnabled = not cameraEnabled
	
	if cameraEnabled then
		toggleBtn.Text = "CAM: ON"
		toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 180)
		enableThirdPerson()
	else
		toggleBtn.Text = "CAM: OFF"
		toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 195, 225)
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 40, 60)
		
		-- Restore default camera controls
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	end
end)
